name: The Berkshires
summary: Western Massachusetts' cultured hills — Norman Rockwell's studio, a giant contemporary-art mill, and the summer home of the Boston Symphony.

foodMustTry.name: A farm-to-table Berkshires dinner
foodMustTry.blurb: The hills are thick with excellent restaurants.

days.label: Day 55 — Rockwell & Stockbridge
days.summary: America's most beloved illustrator, at home in the Berkshires.

item.title: Norman Rockwell Museum
item.blurb: The world's largest collection of Rockwell's work, plus his relocated studio, in the town he painted.

item.title: Tanglewood grounds & Stockbridge Main Street
item.blurb: Walk the summer home of the Boston Symphony (concerts in summer), then the Main Street Rockwell famously painted.

days.label: Day 56 — MASS MoCA & Greylock
days.summary: A giant art mill and the highest point in the state.

item.title: MASS MoCA

location.name: MASS MoCA
location.address: 1040 MASS MoCA Way, North Adams, MA

item.blurb: One of the largest contemporary-art museums in the country, filling a sprawling old electric-works complex.

item.title: Mount Greylock summit
item.blurb: Drive to the highest point in Massachusetts for a 90-mile view and the war-memorial tower.

days.label: Day 57 — South to Hartford
days.summary: Down out of the hills into Connecticut.

commute.scenicNote: South into the Connecticut River valley.
